info.name: Soroban Vesting Platform API
info.description:
REST API collection for the Soroban Vesting Platform backend. Covers all 28 endpoints across Health, Vesting, Token, and Multisig routers.

Set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:3001` (the default) or to your deployed backend URL.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness and readiness checks for the backend service.

request.description: Returns the current health status of the backend service, including network and RPC connectivity information.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Readiness probe. Returns 200 when at least one contract ID environment variable is configured; returns 503 when none are set.

response.name: 200 Ready
503 Not Ready

item.name: Vesting
item.description: Endpoints for managing vesting schedules: create, query, claim, revoke, and pause operations.

request.description: Create a new vesting schedule. `contractId`, `startTime`, `cliffDuration`, and `signerKey` are optional. Amounts are in the token's smallest unit (stroops for 7-decimal tokens).

response.name: 202 Accepted

query.description: Optional. Overrides the VESTING_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Retrieve a specific vesting schedule by its numeric ID.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the VESTING_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Query the amount currently claimable for a schedule. The returned amount is in the token's smallest unit.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Claim all currently vested and unclaimed tokens for the given schedule. The beneficiary must authorise this call.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Revoke an active vesting schedule. Unvested tokens are transferred to `recipient`. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` and `adminKey` are optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Pause the vesting contract. Blocks `create_schedule` and `claim`. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Unpause the vesting contract, restoring `create_schedule` and `claim`. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

query.description: Optional. Overrides the VESTING_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: List all schedule IDs associated with a beneficiary address.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the VESTING_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the total number of vesting schedules ever created.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Token
item.description: Endpoints for the SEP-0041 token contract: metadata, balances, allowances, and state-changing operations.

query.description: Optional. Overrides the TOKEN_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return token metadata: name, symbol, decimals, and total supply.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the TOKEN_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the token balance for a specific address. The balance is in the token's smallest unit.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the TOKEN_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the spending allowance granted by `owner` to `spender`.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Mint new tokens to a recipient address. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Burn tokens from an address. The `from` account must authorise this call. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Transfer tokens directly from one address to another. The `from` account must authorise this call. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Approve a spender to transfer up to `amount` tokens on behalf of the owner. Set `amount` to `0` to revoke an existing allowance. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Pause the token contract. Blocks mint, burn, transfer, transfer_from, and approve. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Unpause the token contract, restoring all token operations. Requires admin authorisation. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

item.name: Multisig
item.description: Endpoints for the N-of-M multisig governance contract: submit proposals, confirm, execute, cancel, and query state.

request.description: Submit a new governance proposal. The `proposer` must be a registered multisig owner. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

query.description: Optional. Overrides the MULTISIG_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Retrieve a specific proposal by its numeric ID.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Confirm a pending proposal. The `owner` must be a registered multisig owner. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Revoke a previously submitted confirmation for a pending proposal. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Execute a proposal once the confirmation threshold is met. This call is permissionless — anyone can trigger execution once enough owners have confirmed. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

request.description: Cancel a pending proposal. Only the original proposer can cancel. `contractId` is optional.

response.name: 202 Accepted

query.description: Optional. Overrides the MULTISIG_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the current list of multisig owner addresses.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the MULTISIG_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the current confirmation threshold (M in N-of-M).

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Optional. Overrides the MULTISIG_CONTRACT_ID environment variable.

request.description: Return the total number of proposals ever submitted to this multisig.

response.name: 200 OK
